comment: This class is quite difficult and requires a lot of work for a FYS. There are significantly easier courses. His grading criteria is unclear, which makes it difficult to succeed. He will accuse you of using AI if you are a better writer. There are 20-40 page readings required for class each time you meet, and you are expected avidly participate.

Please take a different FYS! While content is interesting, I have been extremely confused about Dr. Traugh's expectations. He gives tedious writing assignments, enjoys hearing himself talk, and does not reward hard work or improvement. Grading is VERY picky and specific—the course is over and I still couldn't tell you what he wanted from us.
